item.title: Madras HC upholds order allowing lamp lighting near dargah on Thiruparakundram hills
item.description: Thirupparankundram lamp lighting row: The Court clarified that the lamp may be lit and the number of persons permitted can be fixed, subject to consultation with the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI).

item.title: Bomb alert triggers chaos at Mau railway station in UP, Mumbai-bound train evacuated
item.description: A bomb alert at Mau railway station led to the evacuation of the 15018 down train heading to Mumbai. Security agencies immediately cordoned off the area and launched a detailed inspection with the bomb squad.

item.title: What is Oatzempic? The viral oat drink being compared to weight-loss injections
item.description: Oatzempic is the latest viral weight-loss trend making the rounds online. We explain what the oat-based drink is, how it is made, and what science actually says about its role in appetite control, fibre, and realistic weight-loss expectations.

item.title: Steve Smith leaves behind Shubman Gill, Kane Williamson in WTC with 37th Test century in Ashes
item.description: Steve Smith notched up his 37th century in the fifth and final Ashes Test in Sydney on the third day to put Australia into the ascendancy in the first innings. With this ton, Smith surpassed India's Test skipper Shubman Gill in a major WTC record and also left Kane Williamson behind.

item.title: ISRO’s dust detector successfully tracks interplanetary particles
item.description: ISRO's Dust EXperiment (DEX) marks a significant technological milestone as India's first indigenous instrument designed to detect Interplanetary Dust Particles (IDPs).

item.title: Three people killed in fire at DMRC staff quarters in Delhi’s Adarsh Nagar
item.description: According to the fire department, they received a call at 2:39 am regarding a fire in the residential quarters of the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC).
